valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim Q2 2026, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.peFormula: market capitalisation / net profit, the same ratio as price / earnings per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2025
valuation.psFormula: market capitalisation / revenue, the same ratio as price / revenue per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.pbFormula: market capitalisation / total equity, the same ratio as price / book value per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
